aggregation: macro average over users with at least one test interaction; coverage is catalog-wide

beyond_accuracy_definitions.AveragePopularity: mean raw training interaction count per recommended item
beyond_accuracy_definitions.Coverage: unique top-K recommendations divided by nonpadding catalog size
beyond_accuracy_definitions.IntraListDiversity: macro mean pairwise genre cosine distance per user's list; singleton lists score 0
beyond_accuracy_definitions.Novelty: mean -log2((training item count + 1)/(training interactions + catalog size)) in bits
